description: Unit test for the AttributeDeleted class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package, testing JSON serialization, immutability, equals/hashCode, and exception cases.

classes.name: AttributeDeletedTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the AttributeDeleted class functionality.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that AttributeDeleted instances are immutable and that JsonPointer is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that equals and hashCode methods of AttributeDeleted are correctly implemented.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures that passing a null String as the ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that passing a null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAttributeKey
methods.description: Checks that passing a null attribute key throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Confirms that toJson produces the expected JSON object representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating an AttributeDeleted instance from a valid JSON string.
